name: The Impossible Game Vita
author: MetalSyntax
description: The Impossible Game is FlukeDude's rhythm-platformer, originally released for Android. This port runs the compiled native library directly on the PS Vita using a dynamic loader (soloader) and an Android environment emulation layer. The UI and audio layers, which were Java on Android, have been fully reimplemented natively in C (menu.c, audio.c, texture.c, save.c) for zero-latency input and native performance.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
